description: This file manages WebSocket connections for a real-time application, including connection handling, disconnection, broadcasting events, and utility functions for event creation. It defines classes for session tracking and a hub for managing WebSocket clients, specifically within an asynchronous FastAPI context.

classes.name: SessionSockets
classes.description: Tracks active WebSocket connections for a session.

classes.name: WebSocketHub
classes.description: Manages WebSocket clients, handles connect/disconnect, and broadcast functionalities.

methods.name: int _now_ms()
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: str _event_id()
methods.description: Generates a unique event ID using secrets.

methods.name: RealtimeEvent make_event( event_type: RealtimeEventType, session_id: Optional[str], data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a new RealtimeEvent with specified type, session ID, and data.

methods.name: None connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str)
methods.description: Accepts and registers a WebSocket connection for a given session.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket, session_id: str)
methods.description: Unregisters a WebSocket connection from a session.

methods.name: None broadcast(self, session_id: str, event: RealtimeEvent)
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all WebSocket clients associated with a session.

methods.name: None _safe_send_json(self, ws: WebSocket, payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends JSON data over WebSocket, handling exceptions silently.
